rule: round 3 held-out labels: a session that changes the skill, converter or runtime must not read this file, LABELS-HELD3.md or the templates until release point 3 has scored them (EXCLUSIONS.md)
by: the round-3 bench setup session, from each template's JSON (name, description, nodes, parameters, connections) and PLAN.md decisions (Phase 1 'Decisions taken here', REFERENCE.md outcomes), before running the analyzer on these templates
selection: splits.json heldOutFresh (round 3): every fresh held-out template, all outcome subscription by the analyzer by construction (eligibility)
convention: as labels.json: outcome under the PLAN's default for each question the file cannot settle; questions = kinds whose answer can change the outcome; mayAsk = fine to ask, outcome unchanged; uncertain = where a convention, not the file, decides the label
priorExposure: Before labelling, corpus.json's analyzer outcome, target and wake-up for the Phase 5 overflow entries (12 of these 20) were on screen while checking they had never been in a split, and splits.json heldOutFresh shows every template's wake-up kind. The top-up entries' targets were not looked at. One template (3078) was excluded by rule hand while labelling and replaced by the next draw (2537)

labels.why: Daily 02:30 cron (and a manual trigger) reads every workflow from n8n's own undocumented REST API at http://localhost:5678/rest and uploads each to Drive. It manages n8n: the PLAN blocks the n8n API node for that reason, and the same reason covers n8n's REST API over HTTP; without n8n there is nothing to back up
labels.uncertain: the decision names the n8n API node only; read literally, this is http to localhost, which only a local task reaches (subscription local-task)
labels.ifAnswered: carried anyway → local-task (localhost is the computer's), timezone asked for the 02:30 run

labels.why: Gmail trigger polling every minute with attachments; Read PDF, an OpenAI completion (legacy OpenAI node) that answers true/false, then a Drive upload. Poll every minute needs a local task (cloud tasks run at most hourly)

Chat Trigger (not public) → OpenAI Assistant (an Assistants API thread over a file stored at OpenAI) → reply. The assistant runs through OpenAI with the person's key, not as a Claude model call. The setup steps (Get File → upload, Create new Assistant) have no enabled trigger: unreached

Daily at 15:00: Notion query for today's row, its blocks, image fetch over HTTP, OpenAI Assistant reformat (through OpenAI with the person's key), LinkedIn post, Notion status update. Daily fits a cloud task; time of day needs the timezone

Chat Trigger (not public) loads ./chinook.db from local disk and hands it to a LangChain SQL agent (SQLite) with window memory. The manual branch downloads and unzips the sample database once (setup). A skill on the person's computer, with a local file and a SQLite database as requirements
labels.uncertain: local disk and a SQLite agent: if the disk is only for local tasks, a chat skill cannot read it

labels.why: Manual: Exa findSimilar (POST, search) → up to 10 competitors, each through three agents with Firecrawl and SerpAPI HTTP tools and structured parsers → Notion page per competitor, 2 s wait between. Stored keys for Exa, Firecrawl and SerpAPI, so not the artifact page

Manual: Hacker News comments → Qdrant insert (vector store, embeddings), clearing old points over Qdrant's REST API at http://qdrant:6333; then calls itself ($workflow.id, an Execute Workflow Trigger in the same file: inlined, so the wake-up is manual): Qdrant scroll → a Python Code node (numpy, scikit-learn KMeans) → Information Extractor per cluster → Sheets append
labels.uncertain: the Python Code node needs a Python runtime with numpy and scikit-learn; if the runner cannot carry Python this is a blocker (unsupported)

labels.why: Manual: Instagram media create, status check and publish through the Facebook Graph API node (a stored token), with Send Email (SMTP) notifications on both branches. SMTP has no Claude counterpart: a mail API or the Gmail connector instead is a substitution that needs approval (PLAN's own example)
labels.uncertain: whether a substitution is a blocker or a requirement (labels.json 4110: the analyzer's convention is a requirement)

labels.why: Manual: blog.n8n.io index and five articles over HTTP GET, HTML extraction, markdown, two LLM analyses and an Information Extractor that writes a new article → WordPress draft (stored credential, so not the artifact page)
Chat Trigger (not public) → agent with a Pinecone vector-store tool and window memory; the manual branch loads GitHub's OpenAPI spec into Pinecone once. Vector store as a requirement

Chat Trigger (not public) → API key from a Set node (inline placeholder) → Tavily search and extract (POST) → LLM summary as the reply. Tavily Search and Tavily Extract (the two example nodes) have no input: unreached
Every 15 minutes: Sheets (feeds and seen articles), RSS, dedupe in Code, a text classifier, Jina reader GET, LLM summary → Slack post and Sheets appends. More often than hourly needs a local task

Manual: Set prompts → Perplexity chat completions over HTTP (an LLM API) → clean output. Under the PLAN decision the call is a model step with a model call → Claude substitution requirement; unapproved, it stays http with the stored key, so not the artifact page
labels.ifAnswered: substitution approved (loses Perplexity's web search and citations) → artifact

labels.why: Chat Trigger (not public) → OpenRouter LLM writes search queries → SerpAPI (key from $credentials in the query) and Jina reader GETs in loops → two agents (one with a Wikipedia tool) write the report as the reply. Memory under a fixed session key

Form Trigger with basic auth (one post title) → agent with structured output → X and LinkedIn posts → a form completion page with the post links. The posts need stored OAuth credentials: a task hand-off from the artifact form

Email Trigger (IMAP) with attachments; summaries by three model providers, PDF extraction, image analysis, Drive uploads, Sheets rows, Telegram message to a fixed chat. Reading a mailbox over IMAP has no counterpart (no connector, not HTTP, not in the bundled server's planned tools)
labels.uncertain: if a local task may run an IMAP client, or the mailbox is Gmail (a substitution to Gmail polling), this is subscription local-task
labels.ifAnswered: Gmail mailbox, substitution approved → local-task polling Gmail

labels.why: Form Trigger (no auth, one URL) → HTTP GET of that URL with headers → two security agents → Code builds an HTML report → Gmail send to a fixed address. The form reads like a public tool, so who fills it in decides; by default people in the organisation, with a task hand-off for the send

Manual: prompts → OpenAI caption (OpenAI node) → five OpenAI image calls over HTTP (generations, then edits from the previous image: media through the provider, not model calls) → files merged → upload-post multipart POSTs to TikTok and Instagram. Stored keys, so not the artifact page

Every 6 hours: topic agent, post writer and hashtag agent with structured parsers, OpenAI image generation (OpenAI node, image resource: media through the provider) → LinkedIn post as an organisation. Every 6 hours fits a cloud task

Form Trigger (file upload) fills an in-memory vector store; Chat Trigger (not public) → agent with that store as a tool. The store lives in n8n's process memory, shared between the two executions: it needs a real vector store. Chat is the more demanding wake-up (alsoTargets: form → artifact-form)
labels.uncertain: which of chat and form the analyzer ranks first
